groups.comment: The cards need to come as a grid in desktop mode. currently its all fill and repsonsive.

notes.browse-lamps-a:
The word "Filter" works but "Search" could just have been a proper search bar with a search icon and placeholder text. You don't need a "Search" label's separate text outside. It can be inside as a placeholder and there is no proper spacing between the groups of data. The checkboxes in Type are too far away from each other and so on.

The filter on mobile or in other places should be like a bottom sheet. If there are fewer than 5 filters then it can be just small chips. If it is on desktop then it can be a separate column itself on the left side. Currently it all flows linearly, which is not that great. There should be a price range not just a single price. There should be a price range not just a single price.
notes.browse-lamps-c: Never do this. The person doesn't even find that there are these filters because the number of products can't be controlled so you will never reach the filters till you scroll to the bottom or enter the price directly. It's a bit weird.
notes.browse-lamps-b: Nobody understands the word "options." What do you search for? Price is a single thing and that's it. It's not that great.

groups.comment: Everything looks very tabular, like a key-value pair. It should not be more visual. It is very difficult to do this and there can be more items for each plan so this will not scale that well. It is not very easy to scan here and also you have put "Best" twice. There can only be one "Best" and you need to look into how that can work.

notes.add-task-a: It's better to have notes second item after the task so that people can actually decide what to do, and then put a priority on it and then put a date on it.
